_doc: Hand identity of t2-1 fragments (reid/t2-1.npz, gallery_extract.py order) against the 6 start galleries G0-G5 (G0-2 red, G3-5 blue, left to right on screen). Only fragments I am confident about are listed: 20 of 71 robot fragments. G0 (orange-LED arm, coils on top) and G2 (black shooter wheel) are distinctive; G1/G4/G5 are near-identical silver cages at this resolution, G3 has a white plate and orange bristles. N = not a robot (tower AprilTags, referee). Everything else unlabelled = could not tell. This set is biased toward easy fragments.
